description: The Receive pane provides full-text search over item names and snippets, sort by date/size/type, filter by item type or retention policy, and a toggle between card view and compact list view.

requirements.description: The Receive pane provides: (1) full-text search over item names and text snippet content with results highlighted; (2) sort by upload date (ascending/descending), file size, and item type; (3) filter by item type (file, text) and retention policy (Live, Held, Pinned); (4) a toggle between a card view (grid with thumbnails) and a compact list view. All operations are performed server-side for pagination correctness. The URL query string reflects the current search/sort/filter/view state for shareability and browser back-navigation.
requirements.title: Full-Text Search, Sort, Filter, and Card/List View Toggle in Receive Pane

validation.notes: Vitest: search input debounces at 300 ms before triggering API call
Vitest: sort control emits correct sort_by and sort_dir query parameters
Vitest: filter chips emit correct type and retention_policy query parameters
Vitest: view toggle switches between card-grid and list CSS layout classes
Unit test: list-items API handler parses and applies search, sort_by, sort_dir, type, and retention_policy query parameters correctly
Integration test: upload items with different types and retention policies; query with type=file filter; assert only file items returned
Integration test: search for a text snippet content substring; assert matching items returned and non-matching items excluded
Integration test: sort by size descending; assert items returned in correct order
Search API response returns within 200 ms for up to 10,000 items in the owner's trust group
Playbook: use search, sort, and filter controls in sequence; confirm URL query string updates and back-navigation restores state
Accessibility: search input has aria-label='Search items'; filter controls have appropriate role='checkbox' or role='radio'

title: Search, Sort, Filter & View Toggle
